# SGR Mahal A/C

> A fully air-conditioned wedding hall, with a Ganapathy temple inside, a 200-seat A/C dining hall and 9 A/C rooms, 3 km from Medavakkam.

Website: https://sgrmahal.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 89396 84848

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can SGR Mahal A/C hold?
SGR Mahal's A/C hall seats 500 guests, and its A/C dining hall seats 200. The Mini Hall takes 150–200.

### Where is SGR Mahal A/C?
Plot No 1 & 2, Vijayapuram Extension, Mambakkam Main Road, Sithalapakkam, Chennai 600 126 (Near Sithalapakkam Koot Road bus stop).

### What facilities does SGR Mahal A/C have?
Fully air-conditioned, 100% power backup, Covered & open car parks, Ganapathy temple, Grand staircase, Separate service stairs to kitchen, Hall decoration, South & North Indian caterers, Nadhaswaram & light music, Kerala drums, Audio, video & webcasting, Janavasam chariot, Bridal makeup.

### Which buses stop near SGR Mahal?
MTC routes 51B, 51K, J51, 51J, L51, M51V, M51D, 551 and 551K stop at Sithalapakkam Koot Road, near the hall.

### What does the hall cost?
Hall rentals start from Rs. 3.5 lakhs per day, plus additional charges.

### How do I check if SGR Mahal A/C is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 89396 84848.
